meaning: ST I q.10 a.1 with q.9 a.1: the altogether immutable (in potency in no respect) is eternal in Boethius' typed sense over a duration frame. No succession follows from the sourced q.9 a.1 succession principle, no beginning or end from the open boundary premise, possession of life from the open premise that pure act lives. The conclusion is a separate typed statement; it does not close STMT-IMMUTABLE-IS-ETERNAL, whose primitive Eternal the root routes consume. The Comparator config also verifies three omission controls (successionPremiseNeeded, boundaryPremiseNeeded, lifePremiseNeeded) and a joint model with a pure-act being (premisesJointlySatisfiable).

strong_version_needed.812b52b3-de7d-5982-93a9-e46b6e169616: Its pure-act conclusion quantifies over potency in the subject (MUTABLE_1), so the boundary premise is needed in that sense; the weaker MUTABLE_3 reading STMT-LIFE-BOUNDARY-REQUIRES-SOME-MUTABILITY reaches it only with the open bridge STMT-SUBJECT-OF-ANOTHERS-POWER-HAS-POTENCY (LIFE-BOUNDARY-POTENCY-FROM-SOME-MUTABILITY; batch 4 of #1233).
strong_version_needed.1773079b-236a-5f7d-b1e9-fb8f23202341: The conclusion is about every being in potency in no respect, and its possession-of-life conjunct is needed at each of them; the weak version (whatever has the nine is LIVING_2) covers only pure acts that also have the other eight of the nine, so it does not give the conclusion for a pure act without them (DeiFiliusLivingNineScope.Control.Controls part 2).
